references.retainedVisualIdea: Marked central bed with interrupted strips and inner bars.
Red crossed tiles arranged as lettering; boundary and field actors are visible.
Offset marked bars and pillars around a taller central block.
Three framed bays with a continuous marked band and separated red quadrants.

missions.departureFromReference: Replace nested bars with one broad near island and a short slow band. Existing shared keepers and perimeter patrol define behavior; reference symbols are not used to infer enemy AI.
missions.distinctiveDecision: Choose the direct slow crossing or a longer clear approach; neutralizing the bed makes later returns faster.

missions.departureFromReference: Rework the interrupted inner-bar motif into one permanent central spine and two offset slow beds. The interior start, non-scoring foundations and optional life are explicit original contracts.
missions.distinctiveDecision: Choose which slow bed to reclaim first and which end of the spine gives a better return distance.

missions.departureFromReference: Use two unequal offset landings around a wide slow center rather than the source's literal strips, pillars or actor counts. One known frontier patrol supplies route pressure.
missions.distinctiveDecision: Cross the slow center for a broad capture or link landings through a longer clear approach while reshaping the frontier.

missions.departureFromReference: Replace literal warning lettering with a single readable lethal bed between original refuges. Do not copy artwork or infer damage tolerance from the source screenshot.
missions.distinctiveDecision: Enclose and neutralize the marked bed before crossing, or preserve a wide outside route.

missions.departureFromReference: Simplify the offset pillar motif into two lethal rows with broad clear end routes and two foundation refuges. Retain shared measured threats rather than matching source actor counts.
missions.distinctiveDecision: Neutralize the nearer row first or loop around both ends to reach another return surface.

missions.departureFromReference: Combine the already-taught material motifs around an original three-rectangle cross. The start is inside the reclaimed cross; no new mandatory rule or directional drift is added.
missions.distinctiveDecision: Open the slow western route or the lethal eastern approach while keeping the central cross useful.

missions.departureFromReference: Turn three framed bays into three separated, connectable refuges around two offset material channels. No copied quadrants, relay gates, coordinates or guessed actor behavior.
missions.distinctiveDecision: Choose the order of island connections and whether the optional freeze detour improves an ambitious enclosure.

evidence.masteryScope: Seven legal Standard/immediate/seed1 goal-predicate routes; not implemented awards, all-preset or human qualification.
evidence.limitations: Legal omniscient routes prove solvability for sampled inputs, not difficulty, enjoyment, arbitrary-delay safety or mastery. Pacing and alternate-route review remain open.
